:::{#def-fold-assignment}
#### Fold assignment

Given [folds](#def-folds) $\fold{1}, \ldots, \fold{k}$,
the **fold assignment** $\foldof{i}$ of observation $i$
is the index of the fold that contains it:

$$
i \in \fold{\foldof{i}}.
$$ {#eq-fold-assignment}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

The fold-assignment function $\foldof{i}$ follows @hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1].
:::

:::
